interpretation.required_A_multiplier_at_fixed_D0_C: Multiplier on A required to satisfy the one-pole surface with D0 and C fixed.
interpretation.required_C_multiplier_at_fixed_D0_A: Multiplier on C required to satisfy the one-pole surface with D0 and A fixed.
interpretation.required_D0_multiplier_at_fixed_A_C: Multiplier on D0 required to satisfy the one-pole surface with A and C fixed.
interpretation.required_P0_multiplier: Multiplier on P0 required to hit P0_target with the frozen candidate shape.

mechanism_assessment.normalization_gap_interpretation: required_P0_multiplier measures the outgoing/normalization amplitude multiplier at fixed shape.
mechanism_assessment.one_pole_gap_interpretation: At fixed A and D0, C must be multiplied by the reported required_C_multiplier. Equivalently, at fixed A and C, D0 must be multiplied by the same factor.
mechanism_assessment.suggested_missing_mechanism: new physical support that increases C or D0 by order required_C_multiplier, plus an outgoing/mixed-sector normalization mechanism if required_P0_multiplier remains large
